title: What If a Sugar Cube of Neutron Star Hit Your Table?
text:
NASA: one sugar cube of neutron star material would weigh about a billion tons on Earth, about as much as a mountain. The star packs more mass than the Sun into a ball about 12 miles across, and anything dropped 1 meter onto it hits at around 1,400 km/s, stretched into a stream on the way down.

Follow for one impossible what-if a day.

Source: https://imagine.gsfc.nasa.gov/science/objects/neutron_stars1.html
Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neutron_star
